name: 0.1-72-02c5ecb
notes: Clouds to fly through, a vapor cone at max-Q, the sky turning black and Earth's limb rising into view. The gravity turn now starts gently at 1 km and never swings faster than 2.5 degrees a second in thick air; leaning past the limit gives you 0.7 s to come back, with the LEAN bar flashing red.
